description: This file implements the MembershipTableManager class in Orleans runtime, responsible for managing silo membership state, including periodic refreshes, status updates, gossiping, and handling suspected or failed silos within a Orleans cluster.

classes.name: MembershipTableManager
classes.description: Manages cluster membership, including maintaining local silo's status, periodically refreshing membership info, handling gossip, suspecting/failing silos, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the membership table at a point in time.

classes.name: SuspectOrKillRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to suspect or kill a silo, used in concurrent processing of such requests.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes membership table, performs initial refresh, and detects node migration.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the membership state.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the local silo's 'IAmAlive' timestamp in the membership table.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the silo's status in the membership table and gossips the change.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Enqueues a request to attempt killing a specified silo.

methods.name: ProcessSuspectOrKillLists
methods.description: Processes queued suspect or kill requests, attempting to perform the requested actions.

methods.name: InnerTryKill
methods.description: Performs the actual attempt to mark a silo as dead in the membership table.

methods.name: InnerTryToSuspectOrKill
methods.description: Attempts to suspect or kill a silo based on votes and membership info.

methods.name: DeclareDead
methods.description: Marks a silo as dead in the membership table and gossips this status.

methods.name: GossipToOthers
methods.description: Gossips status updates to other silos.
